title: Owner half · the co-founders, two endings (after the keeper intro)
technique: The keeper intro (H240 take 2, 0-15 s) is never re-rendered. One 15 s owner-only take starts from its last frame and follows a 5-panel storyboard with varied angles; ending A (he stands) is gated, ending B (he stays seated) is the alternative. Music goes in the edit.
story: 0-15 s · Keeper intro (H240 take 2, unchanged): the cat lady can't find whether Fig & Cedar is safe for cats and leaves; the High flip lands on the owner at her desk.
15-18 s · Wide, from high: her co-founder beside her. She, quiet, a little sad: “Damn... what's going on with Fig and Cedar?”
18-21 s · Low angle on him. A: he stands up, hands in pockets. B: he stays seated, leaning back. “Yeah, I told you. Customers just aren't into Fig and Cedar.”
21-23 s · Close-up on her, quietly impressed: “Damn, you just know things.” Their name badges read CEO and VISIONARY.
23-24 s · Overhead: she clicks the red X, Fig & Cedar is deleted. 24-27 s · She blows out the candle as their dog trots past; Scout: “Don't guess why your shoppers don't buy.”
27-30 s · End screen: “Scout interviews your shoppers for you. Get free early access.”

shots.what: Panel 1. From the intro's last frame the camera rises and pulls back to a wide, high angle: he sits beside her; she rests her chin in her hand, a little sad. Badges CEO / VISIONARY on their sweaters. (Ad 15-18 s.)
shots.line: Damn... what's going on with Fig and Cedar?
shots.speaker: Owner (on camera, quiet)

shots.what: Panel 2. Hard cut, low angle on him. A: he stands up, hands in pockets. B: he stays seated, leaning back, arms crossed. Small cocky half-smile; she looks at him. (18-21 s.)
shots.line: Yeah, I told you. Customers just aren't into Fig and Cedar.
shots.speaker: Co-founder (on camera)

shots.what: Panel 3. Hard cut, close-up on her, three-quarter view: a small, quietly impressed smile; CEO badge at the bottom of frame. (21-23 s.)
shots.speaker: Owner (on camera)

shots.what: Panel 4. Hard cut, overhead onto the desk: her cursor clicks the red X on Fig & Cedar (212 in stock, 3 sales); the row disappears. (23-24 s.)
Panel 5. Table-height close shot: she blows out the jar; the wicks smoke while their dog trots across behind the desk. (24-27 s.)
shots.line: Don't guess why your shoppers don't buy.
shots.speaker: Scout (off screen)

shots.what: Hard cut to the H158 end screen. (27-30 s.)
shots.line: Scout interviews your shoppers for you. Get free early access.
shots.speaker: Scout (off screen)
